description: This file contains the class RandomGeneratorFactory, which provides static utility methods for creating and configuring instances of RandomGenerator based on Java's Random class, including seed conversion and wrapper creation.

classes.name: RandomGeneratorFactory
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for creating and configuring RandomGenerator instances in Java.

methods.name: createRandomGenerator
methods.description: Creates a RandomGenerator that wraps the provided Java Random instance.

methods.name: convertToLong
methods.description: Converts an integer seed array to a single long seed value using a prime-based combination.
